name: sup_torsionBySet_ideal_eq_torsionBySet_inf
statement: Ideal R) {hc : P ⊔ Q = ⊤} : torsionBySet R M ↑(P) ⊔ torsionBySet R M ↑(Q) = torsionBySet R M ↑(P ⊓ Q)

name: supIndep_torsionBySet_ideal
statement: (S : Set ι).Pairwise fun i j => p i ⊔ p j = ⊤) : S.SupIndep fun i => torsionBySet R M <| p i

name: disjoint_torsionBySet_ideal
statement: Ideal R} (hc : P ⊔ Q = ⊤) : Disjoint (torsionBySet R M ↑(P)) (torsionBySet R M ↑(Q))

name: exists_isTorsionBy
statement: R} (hM : IsTorsion' M <| Submonoid.powers p) (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (s : Fin d → M) (hs : span R (Set.range s) = ⊤) : ∃ j : Fin d, Module.IsTorsionBy R M (p ^ pOrder hM (s j))

have_tree.type: pOrder hM (s i) ≤ pOrder hM (s <| Option.get _ hoj)
